description: This Java class 'CassandraToSqlTable' handles migration of data from a Cassandra column family to an SQL table, including batch processing, data validation, and constraint handling.

classes.name: CassandraToSqlTable
classes.description: A class for migrating data from Cassandra column family to SQL table with batch processing, data validation, and constraint handling.

methods.name: migrateToSql
methods.description: Performs migration of data from Cassandra to SQL, including schema validation and batch insertion.

methods.name: extractBatchData
methods.description: Extracts a batch of rows from Cassandra result set iterator.

methods.name: extractRowData
methods.description: Extracts data from a Cassandra row into an array of column data.

methods.name: validateColumnData
methods.description: Validates and truncates data according to column size constraints.

methods.name: batchInsert
methods.description: Inserts a batch of data into SQL with retry logic on failure.

methods.name: handleInsertException
methods.description: Handles SQL exceptions during insert, including constraint violations.

methods.name: dataToString
methods.description: Converts column data array to string for logging.

methods.name: onConstraintViolation
methods.description: Hook for handling specific constraint violations.

methods.name: handleUniqueNameViolation
methods.description: Handles duplicate name constraint by renaming.

methods.name: handleUniqueEmailViolation
methods.description: Handles duplicate email constraint by renaming.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Retrieves a column object by SQL column name.

methods.name: getColumnData
methods.description: Retrieves column data by SQL column name.

methods.name: createCassandraSelectStatement
methods.description: Creates a Cassandra SELECT statement for data migration.

methods.name: createSqlInsertStatement
methods.description: Creates a prepared SQL insert statement based on columns.
